\section{Comments}
% [K1] a whole-line comment
Text with a trailing comment. % [K2] trailing comment after code
A line ended by a bare percent% [K3] the newline is suppressed, so this joins
ed word.
%% [K4] a double-percent banner
%
50\% of this sentence is not a comment. % [K6] escaped percent
% [K7] commented-out code:
% \usepackage{neverloaded}
% \input{sections/never}
% \begin{figure}[t] \includegraphics{x} \end{figure}
% \bibliography{old} \end{document}
% [K8] a multi-line \iffalse block. It holds an unbalanced \begin, an input
% of a missing file, and the math symbol \iff, which is not a conditional.
\iffalse
  \section{Dropped}
  \input{sections/Missing-Draft}
  \begin{itemize}
  $A \iff B$ \undefinedcommand
  \ifnum1=1 nested and balanced \fi
\fi
Inline \iffalse hidden text \fi visible text.% [K9]
\ifnum0=1 a numeric false test used as a comment \fi% [K10]
% [K11] comment-package environment; the body is never tokenized
\begin{comment}
\section{Not here} \verb|unclosed
\end{comment}
\begin{gmhidden}
Excluded by \excludecomment in body/macros.tex. [K12]
\end{gmhidden}
\begin{gmshown}
Included by \verb|\includecomment|.
\end{gmshown}
\gmignore{\undefinedcommand discarded by a macro}% [K13]
\gmnote{a draft note, shown because the draft-notes flag is true}% [K14]
\ifgmcomments never shown\fi
